name: Jarvis
postCreateCommand: echo 'Codespace ready. Secrets and user-specific config can be set here.'
postStartCommand: pkill -9 -f 'hermes.*gateway' || true; nohup node /workspace/proxy/proxy.js > /workspace/proxy.log 2>&1 & export HERMES_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1; nohup /home/codespace/.python/current/bin/hermes -p default gateway run > /workspace/gateway.log 2>&1 & curl -s -X POST https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage -d chat_id=${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID} -d text="Codespace started: proxy on 4000, Hermes gateway on 8642" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
